text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—And that concludes the first aid procedure.
Make sure to remember it well and prepare for emergencies.

On the grounds, practical training for first aid on injuries
was taking place. ...Let's observe.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please divide into groups, assign roles,
and practice 'first aid for injuries.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us decide the roles! First—
as for administering the first aid, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do 'furst aid' too!
I'll totally rescue them!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I will play the injured person...
P-Please take good care of meesh...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Since we are performing roles, we must give it our all!
Let us make this first aid drill full of dramatic realism!

text_block_list.name: Doto & Urara
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Roger that!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then, let us begin from the scene before the injury...
during training!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-All right... I'll run with all my might~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa-oof!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That made a huge thud!
Are you okay, Doto-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorryyy~!
I actually fell down for real...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What passionate, dedicated acting...!
...Are you truly unhurt, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm fineee...!
L-Let's continue...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Umu! ...Then, let me ask once more!
'Doto, are you hurting anywhere?'

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah! My leg hurts so muchhh...!
Um... I-I sprained itttt...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fret not! I am by your side!
Come, lie down just like that—
and entrust everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san...!
Hawawa... So magnificent...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Umu, your complexion looks well!
Urara-kun, let us commence first aid at once!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! They taught us earlier that
'it's good to cool it down,' so I brought an ice cream bar!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What splendid quick thinking!
Come, let us apply it to Doto's injured area immediately!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This ice cream... this ice cream~...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Urara-kun? What is the matter!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uuu... ice cream... looks so tasty...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is alluring indeed... but please endure for now!
Fear not, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Besides! Eating ice cream together with a healthy,
vigorous Doto will surely taste far more delicious!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
!! Yeah, you're so right!
Doto-chan, get better soon so we can
eat ice cream together, okay?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, friendship as beautiful as bel canto!
I too shall stake my very being to save Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san, Urara-san...!
Ahhh, thang you so muchhh~~~!!

Haru Urara applied the ice cream to the injured spot,
and TM Opera O wrapped the bandage. And thus,
the first aid practice was splendidly completed.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes the first aid drill.
Especially Opera O-san's group, your teamwork was wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Substituting ice with an ice cream bar was also very resourceful.
Be sure not to forget what you practiced today!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I gladly accept your words of praise!
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
